stances.summary: Iranian regime exploiting U.S. munitions constraints and domestic political divisions
stances.quote: Despite the enormous suffering of the Iranian people, the Iranian regime appears emboldened to continue fighting amid reports of dwindling U.S. munitions stockpiles and growing criticism of Israel in U.S. domestic politics. CNN with @kaitlancollins.

stances.summary: Contrasts Trump's deal-seeking approach with Tehran's long-term strategic posture
stances.quote: Trump has been searching for a knockout punch or a quick deal to end the war. An undeterred Tehran is playing the long game, driven by resistance, revenge, and revolutionary ideology. CNN with @kaitlancollins

stances.summary: Questions claims Iran's leaders becoming more reasonable without evidence
stances.quote: Trump and Vance have said Iran’s new leaders are more reasonable, and are rethinking their revolutionary ideology. We haven’t yet seen any outward evidence of this, and much evidence to the contrary. CNN with @dstroul on the uneasy U.S.-Iran ceasefire.
